highlights: Database schema changes detected (Doctor/Pharmacy latitude/longitude) without migrations.
Visit start geofencing enforcement added; behavior changes when account coordinates are present.
New Excel export endpoint added; currently loads all rows in memory.

findings.title: Schema changes without a migration (Doctor/Pharmacy latitude/longitude + indexes)
findings.details: SQLAlchemy models now include Doctor.latitude/longitude and Pharmacy.latitude/longitude plus location indexes. On an existing database, ORM queries may fail with missing-column errors unless a migration is applied.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an Alembic migration (or equivalent) to add these columns and indexes; ensure downgrade path is included. Consider backfilling nulls safely.

findings.title: Geofence validation added but missing edge-case handling and feature gating
findings.details: validate_geofence() does not handle disabling via radius=0 (uses `or`), does not log failures, and geofencing enforcement may cause operational friction when account coordinates are present but inaccurate. Current behavior is a no-op when target coordinates are null, so deployment impact depends on data quality.
findings.suggested_fix: Use explicit None-check for radius overrides, add structured logging on failures, add an admin override/feature flag, and add tests covering within/outside radius and missing coords.

findings.title: Excel export endpoint may be memory-heavy for large datasets
findings.details: The Excel export currently queries `.all()` and builds a standard Workbook in memory before returning a BytesIO. This can be slow and memory-heavy for large datasets. Column widths are fixed rather than auto-sized, and GPS columns use truthiness checks that drop legitimate 0.0 values.
findings.suggested_fix: Consider openpyxl write-only mode for large exports, compute column widths based on observed max lengths, and use `is not None` checks for coordinate fields.

findings.title: Offline queue implementation exists but is not integrated and may fail lint
findings.details: ALQASEER-PWA offline queue module is present but unreferenced. It imports unused helpers from idb-keyval and does not implement true exponential backoff delays or conflict handling as described in the manifest.
findings.suggested_fix: Integrate via a hook/component, remove unused imports, and implement backoff + conflict strategy. Add basic unit tests if the project uses vitest/jest.

notes: RBAC protections appear present on key endpoints, but Phase 1 RBAC hardening requires an explicit audit of reports/collections/targets/stock routers and corresponding tests.
No destructive operations were performed; a lightweight snapshot of current changes was captured under artifacts/snapshots/.
